title: QuakeWorld.nu
wikitext:
[[QuakeWorld.nu]], often just referred to as 'qwnu', is a QuakeWorld web site that strives to be ''the'' QuakeWorld community site and, through it's sub-sites, be ''the'' site you go to for all QuakeWorld-related topics.
This page is not updated for some time, some hosted and subsites are not online anymore. == Website history == Website was launched in the early morning of April, 2nd 2001. This page is archived, [https://web.archive.org/web/20030412002007/http://www.quakeworld.nu/index.php?page=news&id=1 you can check it here].
[[Image:Qwnu_old.jpg|left|thumb|158px|qw.nu v1.5]] [[Image:Qwnu_v2.jpg|left|thumb|142px|qw.nu v2]] [[Image:Qwnu_v2.5.jpg|left|thumb|177px|qw.nu v2.5]]
